reviewer: Separate analysis agent; fresh Python process
scope: All input hashes and event/order coverage; independent sample extraction for first/middle/last unique exposure by original metadata order.
limitations: The reference grid rerun reuses registration.py; it checks reproducibility, not an independent algorithm implementation.
